assisted_rewrite_policy.scope: Controlled assisted rewriting only where needed to satisfy fluency, clarity, coherence, commercial readability, and the existing refine objectives.
constraints: Preserve meaning, chronology, tone, paragraph order, factual content, names, places, dates, numbers, and narrative intent.
Do not summarize, omit, invent, censor, moralize, add commentary, or rewrite freely.
Length variation is allowed only to improve fluency, clarity, coherence, cadence, and readability while preserving substance.

allowed_for: minor expansion or compression required by natural modern English

instructions.goal: Refine the merged English text for fluency, clarity, coherence and commercial readability without altering meaning, chronology or tone. Controlled assisted rewriting is allowed for up to roughly 20 percent of the text, with approximately +/- 10 percent total length variation, only when needed to satisfy this refine contract.
rules: Do not rewrite the book freely.
Apply controlled assisted rewriting only within the 20 percent limit.
Keep total length within approximately +/- 10 percent unless exact preservation is required by structure.
Do not update the setting culturally.
